785 aspis {as-pece'}

來源不詳; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - asp 1; 1

1) 角奎 (埃及眼鏡蛇), 一種很小但很毒的蛇,一口斃命 ，除非把被咬的地方切除 (#羅3:13|)
record.edic_text:
785 aspis {as-pece'}

of uncertain derivation;; n m

AV - asp 1; 1

1) an asp, a small and most venomous serpent, the bite of which
  is fatal unless the bitten part be immediately cut away
